verdict: Spend has nearly collapsed to $3.85 in the latest period, stalling the PCOS and postpartum lead campaign.
diagnosis: Facebook spend totaled $2,330 over 28 days but the daily average sits at $13.63, far below the $600–$1,000 monthly floor most studios need.

signals.headline: Spend crashed to $3.85 latest day
signals.detail: Daily spend fell from a $13.63 average to under $4, suggesting the campaign is throttled or nearly paused.

signals.headline: 28-day spend only $2,330
signals.detail: Below the $1,500 monthly threshold that lets Facebook exit learning phase for single-location studios.

signals.headline: 346,446 impressions logged this period
signals.detail: Reach volume is healthy but no lead or conversion data is visible to judge whether spend is producing bookings.

signals.headline: Zero visibility on leads or pipeline
signals.detail: No CRM, organic, or Google Business data this period. Impossible to confirm cost per lead or trial bookings.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Personal training and boutique studios run the highest cost per lead on Meta. Fitness still posts the highest conversion rate of any industry at roughly 14%.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: January campaigns run 30–50% more expensive as fitness advertisers flood the auction. October is a lower-cost window to build pipeline before the New Year rush.

competitor.label: CATEGORY
competitor.body: Boutique studios are outperforming big-box gyms on retention. Niche positioning like postpartum and PCOS is exactly where studios are winning members in 2026.

recommendations.title: Investigate why daily spend dropped to $3.85
recommendations.detail: Check whether budget was paused, capped, or exhausted. A near-zero latest day suggests the campaign is not delivering, which stalls lead flow entirely.

recommendations.title: Restore spend to at least $30–$50 per day
recommendations.detail: Consider rebuilding toward a $1,000–$1,500 monthly floor so Facebook can stabilize delivery. Boutique niches need consistent spend to hit reliable cost per lead.

recommendations.title: Connect lead and CRM data to this report
recommendations.detail: Without lead counts, cost per lead, or trial bookings, performance cannot be judged. Worth exploring a tracking fix before the January rush.
